test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a group of 5 friends, J, K, L, M and N, all scored different marks. J scored higher marks than L and N, but less marks than K and M. K. scored more marks than M. L did not score the least marks. Who scored the least marks?
solution:
In a group of 5 friends, **J, K, L, M and N**, all scored different marks. 

1. J scored higher marks than L and N, but less marks than K and M. 

K, M > J > L, N

2. K scored more marks than M. 

K > M > J > L, N

3. L did not score the least marks. 

K > M > J > L > N

Clearly, N scored the least marks.

Hence, ‘**N**’ is the correct answer.
